notes.title: July 22, 2025 patch
notes.content:
[b]Convenience optimization:[/b]
1. Added automatic attack steering function (Settings-Game-Automatic attack steering)
2. Added screen vibration switch
3. Added handle vibration switch

[b]Gameplay adjustment:[/b]
1. Increase the bonus of endurance to life limit and physical defense
2. Increase the bonus of spirit to magic limit and magic defense
3. Adjust the knight's "heavy warrior" talent, the new effect is: "Get melee attacks based on physical defense, skill strength based on magic defense"
4. Adjust spirit attributes: Now spirit attributes will increase a small amount of magic recovery

[b]Problem repair:[/b]
1. Fix map collision problem
2. Fix the abnormal attack speed of ranger
3. Fix the abnormal animation of "Knight"
4. Fix the problem that items cannot be taken out of the account storage

notes.title: Final Chapter - The Fallen Ruins
notes.content: [p][b]1. Added challenge mode[/b][/p][p]After death, all equipment and items on the body will be dropped, and the player cannot be resurrected. Players can choose the corresponding mode after creating a character. Existing characters cannot change the game mode, and the default is normal mode.[/p][p][b]2. Added the final chapter map, new quests and new monsters[/b][/p][p]The final chapter of the fallen ruins has been launched, and the tavern owner in the town will guide you to the new map.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43214047/8ca4af8783dcdce960b40faaec960af6774d668a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]3. Convenience optimization[/b][/p][p]Added material strengthening/forging/manufacturing using storage boxes[/p][p]Added storage boxes that can store gold coins[/p][p]Added account storage boxes, which can exchange items between characters in normal mode[/p][p]Optimized the feel of releasing skills for each profession[/p][p]Adjusted the attack speed of each profession[/p][p][b]4. Bug fixes[/b][/p][p]Fixed some warrior skill bugs[/p][p]Fixed some skill description bugs[/p][p]Fixed some map bugs[/p][p]If you encounter any problems in the game, you can tell me through the feedback in the game, thank you[/p]

notes.title: Updated April 6
notes.content:
1. New profession: Warrior
Use two-handed weapons, have stronger destructive power, and stronger recovery ability, but the price is slower attack.
You can choose "Warrior" when creating a character
2.Fix some text description errors
3.Fix some bugs
4.A new map is being made, so stay tuned

notes.title: November 29 Issue fixed and update notice
notes.content:
[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
1. Fixed the issue that skills can be sold, resulting in unlimited gold coins
2. Fixed the issue that the wrong equipment was forged

[h1][b]Content development[/b][/h1]
1. New profession - Berserker
A melee class that focuses on powerful attacks, with a strong ability to cause damage, but also easily puts one's life on the line.
2. New map
A more difficult area, suitable for fully built characters to explore.

notes.title: November 26. Issue fixed
notes.content:
1. Fixed the problem that the terrain made the player unable to move
2. Added xbox controller input for text boxes
3. Fixed some game crashes
